text:
maria: Quick async check-in for the API edge/routing/rate limit area — what I did / blockers / plan for today

maria: What I did: reviewed the recent 429 spikes on ingestors, traced to a routing rule mismatch + small misconfig on the token-bucket defaults. Pulled logs and a sample trace.

maria: Blockers: need a quick CR + canary policy before bumping defaults in staging. Also need a smoke run after config push.

maria: Today: cut a tiny canary rollout (50%) for the updated rate policy, then monitor error rates & tail latency for 30m. Pinged infra for an extra staging slot.

 dan: ack — saw the 429s this morning too. I can take the CR. Which PR should I look at?

 maria: thanks — PR is linked in the draft: https://git.redwood/infra/prs/834 (note: draft until canary policy added)

 sasha: fyi i've been sampling traces from the timeseries in logs, looks like a burst-shape from a downstream client (>1k reqs/s for ~10s). Token-bucket refill_rate was too low.

 sasha: suggested fix (conceptual): increase refill_rate and add short-term burst_capacity. Also add route-level override for the internal-ingest path.

 leo: pushed a quick config snippet to the branch, added route override for `/v1/ingest` — snippet:

```yaml
routes:
  - path: /v1/ingest
    auth: required
    rate_limit:
      type: token_bucket
      refill_per_sec: 200
      burst: 400
      window: 60
```

 leo: note — I kept the global default conservative so other routes aren't affected.

 sasha: can we add a sampling rule to correlate 429s with user-agent? I want a faster signal.

 dan: i'll add the canary policy to PR and request a quick review from @maria. small question: do we have access to ingress header mapping for the auth header? need it to apply route-level overrides reliably.

 leo: i updated the ingress mapping branch yesterday — `ingress/header-mapping: add auth header -> x-rd-auth` — you should be able to reference `x-rd-auth` in policy rules.

 maria: perfect. @dan when you cut the canary, set rollout=0.5, monitor 200/429 ratio and p95 latency. i'll watch observability (dash link: https://dash.redwood/edge/ingest).

 deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/edge-configs -> sha: a7b9c3f at 2024-09-18T18:00:00Z (job: deploy-879) :rocket:

 ci-bot: CI: PR #834 -> tests: 42 passed, 1 flaky (rerun queued) :white_check_mark:

 dan: taking CR now. blocker cleared (auth mapping present). will also add the UA sampling s3 exporter per @sasha's note. ETA ~ 45m.

 leo: i'll run a quick smoke test against staging once deploy finishes, will post logs if anything odd shows up.

 maria: plan summary: dan -> finalize PR + canary policy, leo -> smoke tests + monitor, sasha -> sampling traces & fraud-like burst rules, i'll watch dashboards and coordinate rollback if needed.

 maria: any other blockers?

 sasha: none from me, thanks.

 dan: all good. ping if the canary needs to be rolled back. :thumbsup:

 leo: thanks, moving to monitoring.

 maria: closing this async loop — will post a short post-mortem if we see regression after canary.
